description: This file defines the AppLayout component, a layout shell incorporating a persistent sidebar and topbar, using CSS grid for layout. It imports external components Topbar, Sidebar, and PageTransition, and organizes the main layout structure for the application.

methods.name: AppLayout({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that provides the main application layout with a fixed sidebar, sticky topbar, and main content area wrapped with PageTransition.
